# Oscorpex

> Oscorpex is an autonomous software engineering company. We turn product ideas into working software built by a 12-role AI agent team (PM, backend, frontend, reviewer, QA) that plans, writes, reviews, and ships through an auditable DAG pipeline. Powered by the Claude API within a multi-provider architecture, with a human in control at every gate via approval queues, audit trails, sandboxing, and budget guards.

## Company
- Name: Oscorpex
- Founded: 2022
- Location: İstanbul, Türkiye
- Website: https://oscorpex.com
- Contact: hello@oscorpex.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/oscorpex/

## What we do
- Autonomous software delivery: from idea to working code, planned, built, and tested by an agent team, with live preview and a cost breakdown.
- The Oscorpex platform: DAG pipeline, automatic replan, skills and RAG memory, observability.
- AI agent orchestration: 12-role Scrum team architecture, review loops, and multi-provider, cost-aware model routing.
- Integration & consulting: secure agent workflows for existing engineering teams.
- Governance & cost control: operator approval queue, audit trail, and a budget circuit breaker.

## Approach
- Security first: sandbox, command policy, and prompt-injection defense.
- Transparent & auditable: full traces, audit logs, and an agent session inspector.
- Human-controlled autonomy: risky steps go through an approval queue.
- Scalable engineering: adaptive concurrency, scheduling, and budget protection.

## Technology
- Core model: Claude API (multi-provider: Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Ollama)
- Architecture: DAG-based pipeline, 12 role-based agents, review loops, quality gates
